posts.text:
As former Mayor of Fergus Falls, my running mate Ben Schierer knows that housing and economic growth go hand in hand.

If workers can't find a place to live, businesses can't grow. Our plan will build more homes, lower costs, and create more opportunities across Minnesota.


benjamin schierer (@benschierer)

When businesses can't find workers and families have nowhere to put down roots — that's a housing problem and an economic problem. Amy’s and my housing affordability plan addresses both.

I don’t know many farmers in Minnesota who have been “doing very well” under this administration.

Between the tariffs and higher costs, life hasn’t gotten easier for them.


The Bulwark (@BulwarkOnline)

Welker: "Gas is up. Diesel is up."

Trump: "It's all coming down as soon as the war's over."

Welker: "70% of farmers say they can't afford fertilizer."

Trump: "The farmers are doing very well."

Welker: "What's your message to farmers?"

Trump: "All of them support me."
